svg.text: Module 04 — Why this does not scale
Shipping a one-line code change with EC2 + Auto Scaling
Total: 12 to 22 minutes, mostly waiting. And the AMI is a full disk image of an entire operating system.
+ capacity grows and shrinks with demand
Auto Scaling did NOT fix this
- your laptop still is not production
And one service still needs one whole virtual machine
Module 05 removes the guest operating system from that picture.
